full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration places a red-haired young woman on a leafy bank beside a stream, with a large white dog resting in front of her. She leans back on one hand near pale tree trunks at the right and turns her face toward the viewer. Long copper hair falls behind a narrow headband. A white blouse with puffed sleeves sits under a deep orange dress whose folds spread across the center and lower right. Brown boots extend toward the dog, which lies with its forelegs crossed at the lower left and looks away toward the water. Behind them, a blue-green stream curves toward the upper left through low grassy banks and scattered pale rocks. Dark green leaves and branches create a dense canopy across the top, opening to a quieter distant field. Floral borders run across the top and bottom of the picture, with narrow patterned strips at the sides. Their muted reds, olive greens and golds echo the colors inside the scene. The illustration uses fine dark contour lines, flat color areas and small textured marks rather than deep painterly modeling. The dog and pale tree trunks provide the strongest light shapes against the dark foliage. Even daylight touches the faces and water without casting a dramatic shadow. Dense foliage and border patterning give the image a woven surface, while the stream supplies a gently receding route through the middle. The overall panel balances the still pair in the foreground with a quiet landscape and richly patterned frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰插画把一位红发年轻女子放在溪边的叶丛岸坡上，前方趴着一只大白狗。她靠右边浅色树干旁，以一只手支撑身体，脸转向观者。长铜红头发从狭窄发带后披下。白色泡袖上衣穿在深橙长裙里，裙褶铺过中央和右下。棕靴伸向狗；狗在左下方前腿交叠，望向水面另一边。两人身后，一条蓝绿色溪流绕过低草岸和散落浅色岩石，向左上方弯曲。深绿叶片和枝条在上方形成浓密树冠，朝较安静的远处草地打开。花草边框横过画面上缘与下缘，侧边还有狭窄纹饰条。低饱和红、橄榄绿和金色呼应画内颜色。插画使用纤细暗轮廓、平涂色块和细小肌理笔痕，而非深度绘画塑形。狗和浅色树干成为深叶丛中最亮的形状。均匀日光照到脸和水，却没有投下戏剧性阴影。密集树叶与边框纹样赋予图像编织般的表面，溪流则在中间提供柔和退远的路线。整块画板把前景静止的一人一狗、安静风景和丰富花纹边框平衡在一起。
style_prompt_en: The image has a decorative print-like surface built from fine dark contour lines, restrained flat color and small repeated texture marks. Deep green and blue-green occupy the largest interior areas, crossed by warm orange, copper and muted gold accents. Pale cream shapes provide clear value breaks inside the dense colored field. A narrow ornamental border encloses the scene and repeats the interior palette in tiny floral and curving motifs. Broad forms remain relatively flat, while rhythmic linework describes folds, foliage and patterned edges. Light is even and diffuse, with brightness expressed through pale color areas instead of strong cast shadow. The composition is shallow near the front but opens along a gentle curved route toward quieter distance. Dark foliage creates a canopy that presses down on lighter forms, and the frame gives the entire image a tapestry-like finish. The visual character is orderly, intimate and richly patterned, with line, color area and border rhythm carrying more weight than realistic depth.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有装饰版画般的表面，由纤细暗轮廓、克制的平面色彩和细小重复肌理笔痕搭成。深绿和蓝绿占据画内最大面积，暖橙、铜色和低饱和金色穿过其间。浅奶油色形体在密集色域中形成清楚的明度断点。狭窄装饰边框圈住场景，以细小花草和卷曲纹样重复内部调色。大形体保持相对平坦，节奏化线条描绘褶皱、叶丛和纹饰边缘。光线均匀漫射，亮度由浅色面积表现，而非强投影。构图在前部较浅，却沿柔和的曲线路线向安静远方打开。深色树叶形成向下压的顶篷，浅色形体在其下显现；边框让整幅图具有壁毯般的完成感。画面性格有秩序、亲近且纹饰丰富，线条、色彩面积和边框节奏比写实纵深更重要。
theme_en: A red-haired woman in an orange dress rests beside a white dog at a tree-lined stream
theme_zh: 一位穿橙色长裙的红发女子与白狗在林间溪旁休憩
name: Eugene Grasset
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
